curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-kufam: JetBrains Mono sets every letter in the same fixed-width box, like typed code. Kufam answers with a sans body of tall lowercase and open, unmodulated strokes, so the pair reads as one contemporary voice.
curated-gf-big-shoulders-stencil-gf-fira: Fira Code sits wide and airy, its c and e open and its letter spacing loose and easy. Big Shoulders Stencil crowds in above it, tight and commanding, so the page feels both blunt and precise.
curated-gf-coming-soon-gf-noto-sans-cher: Noto Sans Cherokee has a large lowercase and open counters, so it reads as friendly and composed. Coming Soon draws casual pen-and-paper letters at one steady weight, while the sans-serif body stays more even.
curated-gf-ruthie-gf-b612-mono: Ruthie writes like quick pen on paper, with a modest lowercase and a little life in every stroke. B612 Mono answers in fixed-width, open-spaced letters, structured and technical, and best kept to a handful of lines.
curated-gf-smokum-newsreader: Smokum opens with a commanding swagger, its strokes swelling and thinning sharply while the letters stay close together. Newsreader follows as a calmer serif, wide-open and gentle, comfortable in small doses beside it.
curated-fredoka-gf-tiro-devanagari-marat: Approachable and round, Fredoka draws every stroke at one weight, so each letter feels open and easy. Tiro Devanagari Marathi answers in an editorial serif voice, with strokes swinging from bold to fine and comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-allan-gf-pt-mono: Bold and expressive, Allan draws every line at one weight, with letters packed tight, while PT Mono spreads out beside it. Its fixed-width letters sit airy and open, and it isn't made for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-italianno-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: Italianno leads with a hand-drawn, pen-flowing look and a modest lowercase that sits low and casual. And LXGW Marker Gothic follows in plain sans, with airy c and e openings that keep a handful of lines easy.
curated-gf-gajraj-one-gf-halant: Commanding Gajraj One swings hard between thick and thin strokes, with compact, enclosed letters set generously far apart. Halant, a text serif, is gentler, with airy openings in its c and e and lowercase that reads big.
curated-gf-klee-one-gf-albert-sans: Klee One opens with a loose, friendly pen-and-paper hand, airy inside and even in weight. Albert Sans answers in wide, steady sans-serif letters that feel modern and professional (maybe for writing prompts journal pages).
curated-space-mono-gf-antic: Evenly drawn lines and airy openings in c and e make this sans-serif read calm and contemporary. Antic stays smooth and professional beneath Space Mono's quirky, fixed-width, code-style headings, which keep their generous letterspacing and technical edge.
curated-gf-flamenco-gf-cactus-classical-: Cactus Classical Serif reads with authority, its open-counter letters carrying just a hint of stroke variation across the line. Flamenco is bolder and even in weight; the classic serif is better for brief reading.
curated-dafont-brusher-fs-literata: Literata is a bookish serif whose strokes swell and thin softly, with airy openings in its c and e. Brusher sits above it as a calligraphic script, drawn at one even weight and full of open counters.
curated-gf-londrina-sketch-gf-pt-mono: Loud, tightly packed Londrina Sketch letters set the tone, with PT Mono's airy, open code-style spacing underneath, handy for a kubernetes dashboard. Londrina Sketch commands attention up top, while PT Mono keeps each small stretch of reading orderly and calm.
curated-fs-britney-gf-antic: Britney writes in a relaxed calligraphic hand, every stroke the same even width. And Antic answers with airy c and e shapes, so the two feel like handwriting beside tidy type.
curated-dafont-keshia-gf-noto-serif-kr: Noto Serif KR opens its letters wide and tall where Keshia stays tightly closed, say, for a fashion week invitation. Keshia's low, compact script sits above that roomier serif, so the two read as one quiet exchange.
curated-boska-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Dramatic and bookish, Boska swings from bold strokes down to hairline-fine ones across every single letter. And Noto Sans Balinese answers with open, uncrowded shapes whose tall lowercase means the body can stay modest in size.
curated-archivo-black-gf-noto-serif-sinh: Archivo Black stamps down heavy, urban letters with low stroke contrast and lowercase that reads huge on the page. Noto Serif Sinhala answers in a softer text serif, bookish, with only a hint of variation.
curated-dafont-highway-gothic-fs-nunito: Highway Gothic draws every stroke at one weight, wide-open and tightly set. Nunito's big, roomy lowercase lets longer reading flow easily, while that sturdy heading above it stays flat and signlike (hospital wayfinding comes to mind).
curated-fs-khand-gf-im-fell-great-primer: Khand opens crisp and contemporary, every stroke drawn at the same weight, tight and direct. IM Fell Great Primer answers with softly modulated strokes, a text serif that reads as authoritative and editorial, best kept to brief copy.
curated-dafont-angeline-vintage-fs-tabul: Romantic pen-written curves, tight and nearly closed, lead in Angeline Vintage (handy for an esports team logo, even). Tabular answers with open, evenly weighted monospace, so the pair reads like warm handwriting beside a cool ledger.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-malaya: Bold and tightly packed, New Title brings big lowercase letters that crowd together with real confidence. Noto Sans Malayalam answers with open, uncrowded shapes, so the pair stays friendly and easy to read.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-libertinus-sans: Libertinus Sans opens with a gentle thick-to-thin rhythm and a contemporary, clean feel. Oswald packs its letters tightly to land confident and strong as a heading, while Libertinus Sans lets a little life show in the body.
curated-gf-give-you-glory-gf-molengo: Friendly and graceful, Give You Glory writes its heading by hand, handy for a macrame and weaving pattern, say. Molengo follows in plain sans letters, clear and uncrowded, so the handwriting leads and the text stays comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-playwrite-za-gf-noto-sans-sha: Relaxed and casual, Playwrite ZA leans on a hand-drawn feel, with short lowercase letters and roomy open counters. Noto Sans Sharada follows as a plain sans whose tall lowercase reads big, so the pair's strongest quality is that low-to-high contrast.
curated-gf-pochaevsk-gf-coustard: Pochaevsk opens with a commanding presence, its uncrowded letters carrying strokes that still have a little life in them. Coustard follows as a plain, bookish serif, better suited to brief copy than to long reading.
curated-gf-borel-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Borel opens with a relaxed, hand-drawn grace, its compact curves nearly closing up while the spacing stays roomy. Chiron Sung HK answers as a text serif with wide-open letters, editorial and made for short stretches of reading.
curated-gf-notable-gf-geist-mono: Geist Mono sets a fixed-width, roomy monospace body with generous space between every letter. Notable answers with lively thick-and-thin strokes up top, loose and open (a shell prompt would sit well beside it).
curated-gf-bonbon-gf-nova-mono: Bonbon's casual pen-and-paper letters could softly dress a crossword puzzle page. Nova Mono answers with tall lowercase letters and no thick-thin variation, so the pair reads as hand against ruler, a quick, friendly stretch of text.
curated-boska-gf-mina: Dramatic Boska opens with strokes that swing from bold to fine. Mina answers in even monoline with wide-open letters, a calm, contemporary sans that keeps its composure (handy for a real estate agent card).
curated-fs-khand-gf-im-fell-dw-pica: Khand draws every line at one consistent weight, giving headings a crisp, compact look that feels thoroughly contemporary and sharp. IM Fell DW Pica answers with softly modulated strokes, a literary text serif that suits brief copy.
curated-gf-alkatra-gf-gentium-plus: Alkatra opens with bold, lively strokes that carry a soft swell and shrink. Gentium Plus answers as a classic serif, open and refined inside each letter, with almost no modulation, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-francois-on: Francois One keeps its sans curves compact and nearly closed, plain and approachable beside the grander letters. Cinzel Decorative opens wide and airy above it, with a gentle thick-to-thin lilt, say, for illuminated initials.
curated-fs-telma-gf-cossette-titre: Telma writes in flowing, pen-made letters with a little life in every stroke, graceful but never showy. Cossette Titre answers with a roomy, neutral sans-serif, its open shapes made for brief stretches of reading.
curated-gf-sankofa-display-gf-hedvig-let: Sankofa Display tucks its openings small and keeps every stroke one weight, say, on a prescription label. Hedvig Letters Serif answers underneath with roomy letters and a large lowercase, and its slightly varied strokes warm up the tight heading above.
curated-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-electrolize: Electrolize keeps its sans letters open and calm, with plenty of air inside. Bruno Ace SC answers with wide, evenly drawn strokes and generous spacing, so heading and body feel related yet clearly different in voice.
curated-gf-kavivanar-gf-ibm-plex-sans-de: IBM Plex Sans Devanagari anchors the body with modern, open clarity, while Kavivanar adds hand-drawn, even-weight lines that feel relaxed, maybe for a hair accessories line. Its generous counters keep a longer stretch of reading comfortable.
curated-unbounded-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi: Noto Serif Gurmukhi reads like a literary text serif, roomy in the lowercase, with a stroke that swells and thins just slightly. Unbounded counters with wide, loose, friendly shapes that announce themselves; the serif simply keeps the reading going.
curated-gf-nothing-you-could-do-gf-belle: Casual and relaxed, Nothing You Could Do looks hand-drawn, with short lowercase letters. Belleza answers with tightly set, open shapes and a little life in each stroke, so the two read together nicely across a handful of lines.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-noto-sans-t: Commanding and ceremonial, Cinzel Decorative spreads its airy letters wide, with strokes that keep a little life. But Noto Sans Thaana answers plainly, its open, generously sized letters feeling friendly, say, for a seance night invite.
curated-gf-oldenburg-gf-kite-one: Oldenburg commands attention with wide, open counters and strokes that hold one weight from end to end. Kite One follows in a friendly sans, its low lowercase letters leaving plenty of air inside.
curated-gf-playwrite-pl-gf-noto-sans-old: Noto Sans Old North Arabian reads big and roomy, its open c and e letting the lowercase breathe, say, for pottery labels. Playwrite PL sits low and hand-drawn above it, friendly and evenly lined.
curated-gf-delius-swash-caps-gf-host-gro: Loose pen-and-paper charm comes first, as Delius Swash Caps draws a compact lowercase in strokes of one even weight. Yet Host Grotesk stays plain sans and open, with airy c and e shapes that keep the pair relaxed and tidy.
curated-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-arrows-gf-gr: Grandiflora One opens with a literary, monoline voice and wide, generous counters. Edu AU VIC WA NT Arrows sits above it, small and hand-drawn and relaxed, like casual handwriting set against something authoritative.
curated-gf-monomakh-gf-sahitya: Monomakh opens with bold, theatrical strokes that thin out to fine edges, which could suit a spellbook cover. Sahitya answers as a bookish text serif, airy in its c and e.
curated-kaushan-script-gf-hepta-slab: Relaxed and bold, Kaushan Script brings a calligraphic hand with close, brushy letters up top. And Hepta Slab, a bookish serif with roomy, even strokes, would read steadily, though not across long paragraphs.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-prompt: Prompt reads as a neutral, approachable plain sans, its lowercase standing tall while the generous, open counters keep every word easy to take in. Under New Title's bold heading, a long read would settle into calm.
curated-dafont-cheri-gf-francois-one: Francois One brings tall lowercase and compact curves that nearly close up, a sturdy and approachable base. And Cheri's calligraphic hand, one weight throughout, adds a cute, inviting flourish, best kept to brief copy.
curated-gf-aladin-gf-almendra: Aladin opens big and commanding, its lowercase drawn at a single weight from stroke to stroke. But Almendra, a text serif with a large lowercase, reads dignified and bookish, best in short stretches.
curated-gf-bbh-bogle-gf-quattrocento: BBH Bogle packs its letters tight, with small enclosed counters and one even weight. Quattrocento answers with open, uncrowded serif shapes and a little life in each stroke, easing the page.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-shanti: Shanti brings a modern, professional sans with breathing letters, which might suit a kids school lunch label. And Chubbo's casual display heading echoes that openness, its airy c and e keeping things friendly.
curated-gf-playwrite-cl-guides-gf-sarabu: Sarabun reads open and approachable, its wide letter shapes giving the eye plenty of room. Sarabun carries the plain sans calm, while Playwrite CL Guides stays graceful, so extended reading would feel a bit uneven.
curated-fs-expose-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab brings a precise, structured slab-serif body with a large lowercase and airy, open letters. Roboto Slab keeps that calm footing while Expose above it turns striking, big and roomy.
curated-shadows-into-light-fs-erode: Erode sets its lowercase large and gives each letter room, with a gentle thick-to-thin stroke that feels dignified. Erode keeps a longer read easy and unhurried, while Shadows Into Light adds a casual, pen-and-paper friendliness above it.
curated-dafont-blackout-fs-hind: Hind reads as a calm, neutral plain sans with tall lowercase letters and plenty of open room inside them. But Blackout packs in tight, closed shapes drawn with even lines, which makes the open body feel even airier.
curated-fs-khand-gf-buenard: Khand draws every line at one consistent weight, crisp and snug, with no thick-thin shift anywhere in the letters. Buenard, a text serif, answers with gentle modulation and a classic feel.
curated-gf-ewert-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Loud, open-spaced capitals and tiny pinched counters give Ewert a commanding presence, say, on a metal band logo. But Noto Serif Tibetan answers calmly, its large lowercase and soft modulation reading as literary and sure of itself.
curated-bungee-gf-b612-mono: Bungee opens loud and playful, its evenly weighted letters tightly closed around small counters, spaced loose across the line. B612 Mono answers with airy, fixed-width letters, better for brief copy than anything long.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Friendly and roundish, Chubbo opens its letters wide with an even, easygoing stroke, while Shippori Antique B1 follows as a quieter, modern sans, equally open but flat in weight. Make Chubbo small and its warmth fades.
curated-gf-monsieur-la-doulaise-gf-camba: Cambay reads open and contemporary, its c and e wide-eyed, which could sit under a vintage handwriting journal. Monsieur La Doulaise, lively and tightly spaced, supplies the personal hand, so it stays best for brief lines.
curated-gf-cherry-cream-soda-gf-pt-sans: Cherry Cream Soda is loud and loosely spaced, the sort of lettering you might spot on a sports bar menu. PT Sans follows with open, friendly shapes, and a modest size keeps the pair comfortable.
curated-fs-excon-gf-smooch-sans: Approachable sums up Excon, with tightly set letters, wide-open shapes and lowercase that reads big. Smooch Sans, a plain sans, keeps its own pace: clear, uncrowded letters with generous lowercase height.
curated-dafont-adrenaline-gf-aoboshi-one: Loud, compact, and commanding, Adrenaline could headline an election campaign flyer with its tight counters. And Aoboshi One answers with petite, single-weight text serif letters, never meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-delius-swash-caps-gf-catamara: Catamaran reads open and approachable, its roomy letters keeping everything calm and neutral. Over a longer stretch, Delius Swash Caps adds a relaxed pen-and-paper warmth to a taller sans body, fitting a gratitude journal entry.
curated-gf-yanone-kaffeesatz-gf-montagu-: Montagu Slab opens with tall lowercase and airy c and e shapes, softly modulated. Yanone Kaffeesatz sits above it, friendly and tight, a good fit (say, for an online quiz app).
curated-gf-ruthie-gf-zalando-sans-expand: Zalando Sans Expanded spreads its sans-serif letters wide and lets them breathe, feeling contemporary and clean (think milestone cards, maybe). Ruthie's loose pen-and-paper hand brings a relaxed, personal warmth to the page.
curated-gf-coming-soon-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab reads as a dignified, refined serif, its big, roomy lowercase stretching out comfortably but best taken in small doses. Coming Soon's even-weight pen strokes sit above it like a casual handwritten note.
curated-gf-chokokutai-gf-caudex: Caudex reads open and dignified, its counters roomy and its strokes gently modulated. Chokokutai grabs attention with sharply swelling strokes and tight curves, while Caudex does its best work in short stretches of calm, authoritative reading.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR reads open and roomy, its big lowercase giving every line air. New Title steps in above with a bold, tightly spaced lowercase, loud and modern (handy for an investor pitch deck).
curated-gf-playwrite-nz-guides-fs-bespok: Playwrite NZ Guides writes with a low-slung lowercase and one even, hand-drawn line weight. Bespoke Serif stands taller beneath it, its text serif strokes swelling and thinning with a dignified, authoritative air.
curated-gf-elsie-gf-esteban: Esteban opens things up with generous counters and tall lowercase letters, a serif that moves at a calm, even pace. Esteban keeps its stroke weight only slightly varied and reads comfortably in small doses, while Elsie goes bold to fine for drama.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-phoen: Alternative and a little distressed, Special Elite leads with big lowercase letters that breathe (dad hat embroidery might love that). Noto Sans Phoenician stays modern and wide open, with tall lowercase that reads cleanly beneath it.
curated-gf-benne-bitter: Benne opens with a gentle thick-to-thin rhythm and a dignified, classic air. Its strokes carry a little life, while Bitter, the slab-serif, stays low and dependable with its generous lowercase height.
curated-ultra-gf-science-gothic: Dignified and vintage, Ultra carries tight little counters and strokes with a bit of life, giving each word real presence. Science Gothic sits beneath it, a sans with roomy, open letters drawn in one even weight.
curated-gf-kavivanar-gf-datatype: Loose and friendly, Kavivanar draws its heading in one easy line, say, for a tour poster. Datatype follows in tidy monospace, every letter taking the same width, so it suits brief bursts rather than long paragraphs.
curated-gf-zilla-slab-highlight-gf-lustr: Zilla Slab Highlight pulls its curves tight and nearly shut, with strokes that swell and thin out sharply. Lustria opens up around it, a text serif with softer modulation and breathing letters.
curated-dafont-magnolia-sky-fs-tabular: Magnolia Sky writes in a soft, calligraphic hand, its letters leaning in close with roomy spacing around them. Tabular answers in evenly drawn monospace lines, and it works best across a handful of lines.
curated-fs-britney-gf-electrolize: Britney writes in a relaxed calligraphic hand, every stroke held to the same single weight. Electrolize answers with modern sans letters, roomy inside, which keep the pair feeling comfortable in small doses.
curated-tourney-gf-anek-odia: Tourney draws every line at one even weight, with loose, open spacing and tall lowercase that give it a bold, athletic stance. Tourney hits hard where Anek Odia stays calm, letting its plain sans letters breathe.
curated-gf-medievalsharp-gf-epunda-slab: Bold and commanding, MedievalSharp heads the page with tall lowercase and letters that breathe, while Epunda Slab answers below, dignified and open. Their strongest quality is plain: a heading that commands, a body that reads big.
curated-gf-chango-gf-palanquin: Palanquin keeps its letters wide open, with airy c's and e's that read as calm and contemporary. Palanquin holds up for a handful of lines, while Chango's tight, closed shapes above feel loud beside it.
curated-dafont-birds-of-paradise-fs-reci: Recia, a serif with lively strokes and open counters, reads sharp and authoritative, even on a retro skate rink flyer. And Birds of Paradise brings ornate, luxurious display flourish up top, while Recia handles the comfortable small-dose reading below.
curated-fs-red-hat-display-gf-tiro-devan: Bold and contemporary up top, Red Hat Display draws each line at one even weight, while Tiro Devanagari Hindi follows with literary strokes that swing from heavy to fine. A little goes far with the serif (a food truck logo, maybe).

curated-gf-ga-maamli-gf-m-plus-1: Bold and commanding, Ga Maamli takes the heading with a plain, no-nonsense build. And M PLUS 1 reads neutral and uncrowded underneath, better for brief copy (golf tournament signage, say).

curated-gf-baloo-2-gf-ubuntu-mono: Baloo 2 opens with rounded, uncrowded letters that carry plenty of personality. Ubuntu Mono answers in evenly weighted, tall monospace strokes that stay airy, so a handful of lines reads comfortably but a longer stretch would start to tire.
curated-gf-clicker-script-fs-plein: Clicker Script leans in with a close, handwritten warmth, its short lowercase letters tapering gently, say, for a woodworking shop sign. Plein sits wide open beside it, plain sans and dependable.

curated-gf-averia-serif-libre-gf-new-teg: New Tegomin reads as a dignified, traditional serif, with letters that breathe and keep each line feeling open. Averia Serif Libre adds a bolder hand above it, though it holds up better in brief copy.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-open-sans: Bold and modern, New Title sets large lowercase forms tightly together, while Open Sans answers with airy, open shapes in its c and e. It earns its keep where words run big and few.
curated-gf-vina-sans-gf-gowun-batang: Vina Sans is bold and tightly closed, every stroke drawn at one steady weight, while Gowun Batang opens up airy and literary beneath it. Fine for a haunted tour poster, though a long paragraph would tire it.
curated-gf-germania-one-fs-azeret-mono: Commanding, Germania One sits tall and tight, its closed letters packed shoulder to shoulder. Azeret Mono answers with open, airy monospace shapes, precise and clean, and it is better for brief copy.
curated-gf-rowdies-fs-bespoke-sans: Rowdies comes in loud and commanding, its compact curves nearly sealing shut, while Bespoke Sans stays open and airy beneath it. Longer stretches of that sans would feel tiring, so keep it brief.
curated-gf-jaini-gf-libertinus-mono: Jaini speaks in a big, commanding lowercase, its evenly drawn lines packed tightly together. Libertinus Mono follows with roomy, fixed-width monospace letters whose strokes carry a little life, comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-comic-neue-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and dignified, its serif letters spaced with plenty of room between them. Hepta Slab holds an even weight down a long stretch, while Comic Neue's pen-and-paper heading stays friendly above it.
curated-instrument-serif-zilla-slab: Refined Instrument Serif brings sharp, dramatic thick-to-thin strokes that could headline a neighborhood association logo without much fuss. curated-gf-kirang-haerang-gf-prociono: Kirang Haerang crowds its letters tight, with low lowercase and snug, enclosed counters. Prociono answers with wide-open shapes and an easy, comfortable pace in small doses, while Kirang Haerang is built to grab attention in a headline.

curated-passions-conflict-fs-gambetta: Gambetta reads as a soft, bookish text serif, with roomy letters and only a faint stroke variation. And Passions Conflict leans romantic above it, a calligraphic hand that suits a rehearsal dinner invite.
curated-gf-jersey-15-charted-gf-oxygen-m: Bold and tightly packed, Jersey 15 Charted crowds its letters close with snug, enclosed counters. Oxygen Mono answers in monospace, airy and fixed-width, so keep its size modest for brief lines.

curated-gf-clicker-script-gf-fjord-one: Fjord One opens its counters wide and moves with a gentle thick-to-thin rhythm, standing taller above Clicker Script's squat, tightly knit letters. Clicker Script is best for a handful of lines, while Fjord One carries longer stretches.

curated-gf-expletus-sans-gf-tirra: Expletus Sans takes the lead with a commanding, plain-built display voice that grabs your eye right away. Tirra answers in neutral, open letters, a plain sans that stays quiet and lets the heading speak.

curated-gf-mrs-sheppards-gf-alegreya: Alegreya opens up and breathes, its softly modulated strokes feeling literary and bookish. Over a longer stretch, that classic serif reads easily while Mrs Sheppards huddles tighter and more closed above it, jotted in a casual hand.
curated-gf-playwrite-ca-fs-bespoke-sans: Playwrite CA writes in a personal, even-weight hand with low-slung lowercase. Bespoke Sans answers with sharp, open letters, a little taller, while the script earns its keep big and short.
curated-modak-gf-kadwa: Modak opens with fat, even-weighted letters and roomy counters, a cheerful shout that would suit a set of alphabet flashcards. Kadwa answers in a calm text serif, tall and uncrowded, so the page settles down.

curated-fredoka-gf-tiro-gurmukhi: Soft and round, Fredoka draws every line at a single weight with open, uncrowded shapes. Tiro Gurmukhi answers as a serif whose strokes swing sharply between thick and thin, brief copy suiting it.
curated-fs-telma-gf-fanwood-text: Fanwood Text reads like an old novel, roomy in the lowercase and quietly literary. Telma's flowing, pen-written heading letters loosen the formality above it, and together they keep the page graceful without ever tipping into fussy.
curated-gf-aubrey-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru, a text serif with airy, evenly drawn strokes, might sit nicely in wedding calligraphy and small invitations. Aubrey above it is commanding and bold, tightly packed, with a lot of low-contrast weight.
curated-gf-love-light-gf-amiri: Warm, loose handwriting up top, with roomy letters that lean toward the personal; Amiri follows in a literary serif, wide and tightly set. Brief copy reads best here, and the heading could go bolder.
curated-gf-water-brush-gf-chivo-mono: Chivo Mono reads open and wide, its monospace letters marching in fixed columns beneath Water Brush's snug, low, handwritten scrawl. Meant for short stretches, the pair reads fast and light.
curated-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-gf-ibm-: Relaxed and personal, Yuji Hentaigana Akari looks hand-drawn (maybe for a band logo). IBM Plex Mono answers with typewriter-even, precise monospace letters that never crowd each other, so a stretch of reading stays calm and easy to follow.
curated-gf-rochester-gf-sura: Inviting and personal, Rochester sets its small-eyed, close-packed handwriting low and tight, while Sura opens up beneath it. Sura's classic serif letters breathe easily, so the pair reads loosely, with Rochester leading and nothing long.
curated-gf-coda-gf-oxygen-mono: Bold, wide-open Coda headings announce themselves, while Oxygen Mono follows in fixed-width, airy letters that feel structured and technical. Together the loud heading and the typewriter-even body give each other room, though the monospace tires over long paragraphs.
curated-patua-one-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans opens things up with tidy, uncrowded letters and tall lowercase, all of it tucked in close. Patua One answers with a round, friendly voice, while the plain sans stays quick and composed.
curated-covered-by-your-grace-zilla-slab: Covered By Your Grace greets you with friendly, casual pen-and-paper letters, all drawn at one even weight. But Zilla Slab's sturdy, wide-open build makes a stiff partner, so this pairing isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Understated and graceful, Telma writes its generous, open letters like a quick pen. Noto Sans Brahmi stays neutral and uncrowded beneath it, and with its low stroke variation it reads easily in small doses, never over long paragraphs.
curated-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-old-sout: Commanding is the word for Baumans, whose wide-open letters hold one even weight from the first stroke to the last. Noto Sans Old South Arabian answers with the same open shapes in a plain sans.
curated-gf-akaya-telivigala-gf-google-sa: Google Sans Code reads as a fixed-width monospace, even in stroke and generously spaced, with a precise, technical air. Akaya Telivigala earns its keep as a big, short heading, packing its letters tight around airy c and e shapes.
curated-gf-baloo-tamma-2-gf-holtwood-one: Baloo Tamma 2 opens wide, with a large lowercase and clear, uncrowded shapes. Its open letters set the pace, while Holtwood One SC, a text serif with roomy spacing and tucked-in counters, would tire quickly across long paragraphs.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps its wide, tall letters open and plain. Telma's flowing, pen-written heading letters carry a little life above them, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-special-elite-gf-hahmlet: Distressed and typewritten, Special Elite arrives scuffed, with big lowercase letters and room to breathe. Special Elite handles rough, attention-grabbing character in a heading, while Hahmlet's serif body stays dignified, editorial, and open inside every letter.
curated-gf-bpmf-iansui-gf-wittgenstein: Wittgenstein reads literary and traditional, its text serif letters wide open and swinging hard between thick and fine. Wittgenstein suits brief copy best, since that dramatic stroke contrast could tire the eye over many lines.

curated-gf-erica-one-gf-cousine: Cousine is a tall, fixed-width monospace with airy c and e shapes, ideal for a line of cli help output. Cousine's open, even rhythm sets off Erica One's closed-in, heavy display letters, and it stays comfortable in small doses.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-bbh-hegarty: Kalam opens with a hand-drawn warmth and tightly packed letters, the kind that might sit well in a fitness studio wordmark. BBH Hegarty answers as a plain sans, neutral and compact, with room between its letters.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-blinker: Fixed-width letters give JetBrains Mono a typed-out, code-editor look with plenty of open room. Blinker follows in a plain sans, friendly and tall in the lowercase, so the pair feels approachable.

curated-fs-new-title-gf-sintony: New Title opens with a large lowercase and tightly packed letters, which gives the heading a bold, modern punch. Sintony answers with tall, open sans-serif letters that feel clean and airy.
curated-gf-racing-sans-one-gf-wix-madefo: Wix Madefor Text reads open and wide, calm and contemporary in its manner. Racing Sans One answers with compact, enclosed letters whose strokes swell and thin sharply, loud against that quiet, short-stretch sans-serif body.

curated-fs-new-title-gf-do-hyeon: Do Hyeon reads as a plain, even-stroked sans, its lowercase tightly set and looking big. Do Hyeon keeps that oversized density against New Title's bold, modern heading, so the two sound like one voice.
curated-fs-pencerio-gf-im-fell-english-s: IM Fell English SC opens with a bookish, editorial voice and strokes with life. Its clear, uncrowded letters make short stretches of reading feel easy, while Pencerio's close-set calligraphic hand stays graceful above.

curated-fs-kalam-gf-google-sans-code: Cozy and hand-drawn, Kalam leans in close, its letters nestled together (maybe even for a YouTube channel logo). Google Sans Code answers with even strokes and fixed-width spacing, wonderfully easy to read in small doses.

curated-gf-inspiration-gf-belgrano: Friendly and inviting, Inspiration drops its lowercase low, like a note scribbled by hand.
