curated-dafont-blackpine-fs-bespoke-seri: Blackpine writes in one steady-weight line, a casual calligraphic hand with its letters tucked tightly together. Bespoke Serif follows with a gentle shift in stroke weight, dignified and comfortable in small doses.
curated-almendra-display-gf-ruda: Ruda reads clearly and comfortably, drawn at one even weight with open, uncrowded letters and generous lowercase height. Almendra Display carries the ornate, literary flavor, while Ruda handles the quiet, plain work of being easy to read.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-ancizar-sans: Ancizar Sans reads neutral and modern, its tight spacing keeping each line compact and tidy. Chubbo adds casual warmth with open c and e shapes, earning its keep when set big and short.
curated-dafont-venera-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Venera spreads its letters wide apart, giving headings a modern, airy look at big sizes. Be Vietnam Pro answers with sturdy sans-serif strokes of one weight and tall, open lowercase.
curated-dafont-raustila-zilla-slab: Raustila writes in a tight calligraphic hand, its compact curves nearly closing up, while Zilla Slab stays wide open and sturdy. It earns its place big and brief, since it was never meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-euphoria-script-gf-lexend-gig: Lexend Giga reads airy and even, with no thick-thin variation, and its spacing gives a modern, professional calm. Euphoria Script sits above it like a loose pen note, relaxed and graceful.
curated-gf-museomoderno-gf-aleo: Bold and plain-spoken, MuseoModerno takes the heading and lets its expressive display shapes do the talking. And Aleo answers as a text serif, dignified and classic, its clear letters never feeling crowded.
curated-gf-arizonia-gf-tienne: Tienne reads refined and literary, with generous letter spacing and strokes that carry a little life. Arizonia, up top, is a hand-drawn script whose thick and thin strokes swing hard, casual yet graceful.
curated-ultra-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Wide, evenly weighted letters with plenty of air inside give BhuTuka Expanded One a calm, literary read. BhuTuka Expanded One stays open and relaxed while Ultra squeezes its counters tight, and that tension defines the pair.
curated-dafont-quark-fs-erode: Erode opens with a classic serif's dignity, its lowercase reading big and its letters given room to breathe. Quark answers with evenly drawn, geometric lines that stay crisp and technical.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-ysabeau-infant: Ysabeau Infant reads as a friendly, open sans-serif, easy to imagine under a dinosaur book cover title. Ysabeau Infant echoes the roomy c and e in Chubbo, while Chubbo's chunky, even strokes carry the louder voice.
curated-playfair-display-gf-syncopate: Playfair Display opens wide and bookish, its strokes swelling and thinning with a lively, dignified flourish. Syncopate follows in even lines with roomy letter spacing, so a longer read stays calm and uncluttered.
curated-gf-delius-swash-caps-gf-josefin-: Josefin Slab keeps every stroke one weight, with short lowercase and open, uncrowded shapes. Delius Swash Caps brings a relaxed, pen-and-paper handwriting feel up front, while the serif Josefin Slab stays quiet, bookish and easy over short stretches of reading.
curated-gf-goblin-one-gf-lexend-peta: Goblin One opens commanding and expressive, with a tall lowercase and strokes that swing from bold to fine in dramatic fashion. Lexend Peta answers with a sans of one even weight, wide and roomy.
curated-boska-gf-red-hat-mono: Red Hat Mono reads as a precise, roomy monospace, every letter the same width and drawn at one even weight. Boska's strokes swing from bold to hairline, so the page gets drama above and order below.
curated-fs-britney-gf-gantari: Gantari reads open and easygoing, its sans-serif letters given plenty of room. Britney's monoline script hand carries the loose, expressive mood, while Gantari keeps text approachable and contemporary across brief stretches.
curated-fs-sharpie-gf-crete-round: Crete Round reads dignified and classic, with a calm, familiar serif voice. Sharpie sits above it as a bold, expressive display heading, tightly spaced, with snug counters that close in around each letter.
curated-gf-unna-gf-fragment-mono: Unna swings hard between fat and hairline strokes, tightly set and bookish. It supplies the editorial voice, while Fragment Mono keeps everything precise and even, handy for an architecture decision record.
curated-dafont-helsinki-gf-fragment-mono: Helsinki opens things up with calm, generous letterspacing and a big lowercase that never feels crowded. Fragment Mono follows with the same single-weight evenness, though its typewriter-regular rhythm adds structure, maybe for a screen like an admin settings page.
curated-gf-pattaya-gf-spline-sans-mono: Pattaya sets tight, compact letters whose curves almost close up completely. Spline Sans Mono answers with tall, open, evenly weighted monospace letters, so the pair's real strength is the clear difference between a soft swelling stroke and a flat one.
curated-gf-unkempt-gf-hepta-slab: Commanding and loose-limbed, Unkempt shouts from the top with letters that never crowd, while Hepta Slab answers in a dignified, bookish voice. Give the heading a bit more size and the body will settle in.
curated-dafont-stencil-fs-synonym: Synonym keeps every line at one weight, with wide, open c and e shapes. Stencil comes down on top with swelling, sharply thinning strokes and a tight, commanding grip that a handful of lines can carry.
curated-fs-telma-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed draws evenly weighted lines with a big, roomy lowercase that feels modern and neutral. Saira Semi Condensed reads easily and calmly, though it is really made for short stretches, while Telma adds the graceful pen-written voice.
curated-boska-gf-lato: Bold and theatrical, Boska swings from heavy strokes to hairline ones, giving each heading real drama. Lato handles the plain sans work underneath, with wide-open letters that stay clean, steady and quietly professional.
curated-fredoka-gf-annapurna-sil: Annapurna SIL is a classic serif with a refined, editorial hand. Fredoka draws every line at one even weight, friendly and open, while the body gives a softer thick-to-thin rhythm, so nudge the body size up for brief copy.
curated-gf-tiro-devanagari-marathi-gf-no: Bookish and traditional, Tiro Devanagari Marathi leads with strokes that swell and thin out sharply. But Noto Sans Wancho answers with a large lowercase and open counters, so enlarging it slightly helps.
curated-gf-baloo-paaji-2-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px has a bookish, dignified manner, with a big, roomy lowercase and airy openings in its c and e. Slabo 13px then sits under Baloo Paaji 2, whose bold, commanding display letters read big and wide open.

curated-gf-playwrite-dk-loopet-gf-josefi: Loose pen-and-paper loops lead the way, drawn in one even weight, with a modest lowercase that never shouts. Josefin Slab answers in a text serif, bookish and uncrowded, and handles only a handful of lines.
curated-gf-italianno-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Italianno's dramatic thick-to-thin strokes give its snug, hand-drawn lettering a casual flourish that could easily head a guest book. Nanum Myeongjo answers with a classic serif that breathes, calm and refined.
curated-gf-romanesco-gf-chakra-petch: Casual and inviting, Romanesco scribbles its heading like pen on paper, tight little counters and all, say, for a travel journal. Chakra Petch answers with open, even strokes, contemporary and brisk.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-victor-mono: New Title is bold and modern, with a big lowercase and tight spacing that crowds the line. Victor Mono answers with evenly drawn strokes and roomy monospace letters that give the page room to breathe.

curated-space-mono-gf-dosis: Space Mono sets every letter in its own fixed-width box, quirky and code-like. Dosis answers with close-set, open-countered sans-serif letters, so a long read glides along evenly and feels calm.
curated-gf-mr-bedfort-gf-science-gothic: Mr Bedfort sets its relaxed, low-slung lowercase in wide-open shapes, with just a hint of pen pressure. Science Gothic follows in evenly drawn, roomy lines that stay comfortable to read in small doses.
curated-fs-teko-gf-albert-sans: Teko opens bold and tightly set, maybe on an employee id card. Its even strokes do the loud work, while Albert Sans, a plain sans, keeps its wide-open shapes calm and easy to read.
curated-gf-sniglet-gf-arvo: Sniglet opens with round, commanding letters of one even weight, wide open inside and hard to ignore. And Arvo, the text serif, answers with the same open counters but a stroke that varies.

curated-gf-jacques-francois-gf-anonymous: Anonymous Pro lays down even, typewriter-width letters with airy c and e, so the monospace feels precise and technical. And Jacques Francois, with its short lowercase and strokes swinging from bold to fine, suits a handful of lines like a bingo card.

curated-boska-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Dramatic is the right word for Boska, whose strokes swing from bold to hairline fine. Noto Sans Kawi follows in a clean, neutral sans-serif, its open letters giving that drama room to breathe.
curated-gf-handlee-gf-domine: Pen-drawn and relaxed, Handlee leans on wide-open letters and an easy, casual grace. Handlee does warmth best, a hand-drawn voice that holds up in brief copy, while Domine's tall lowercase and clear shapes carry steadier reading.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-englebert: Englebert keeps things even and open, which could suit paper goods and planners nicely. Bonny's literary heading, with its mildly swelling strokes, gives the sans below it a warm, bookish lead-in.
curated-dafont-conthrax-gf-fauna-one: Wide, geometric, and airy, Conthrax draws every stroke at one even weight. Fauna One answers in a classic serif with a big lowercase that breathes, and it reads dignified where Conthrax announces itself.
curated-gf-grape-nuts-gf-manjari: Open, generously drawn counters and evenly drawn lines make this body feel approachable and professional. Manjari holds a steady, moderate lowercase height, so a handwritten heading in Grape Nuts feels looser beside it.
curated-gf-syne-tactile-gf-odor-mean-che: Expressive and roomy, Syne Tactile opens its letters wide, while Odor Mean Chey pulls its curves nearly shut, a fit for a nail salon logo. Syne Tactile grabs attention up top; the text serif keeps to brief lines.

curated-dafont-satisfaction-gf-rosarivo: Rosarivo, a classic serif with open, uncrowded letters and low-slung lowercase, sits beneath Satisfaction's casual, compact, enclosed script forms. Satisfaction is not meant for long paragraphs, so give it room.

curated-gf-big-shoulders-gf-odor-mean-ch: Tall and tightly packed, Big Shoulders announces itself up top, while Odor Mean Chey answers in compact, nearly closed curves. It's a dignified classic serif that suits, say, an evening gala program, and stays comfortable in small doses.
curated-dafont-stilu-fs-hoover: Hoover is a text serif with a big, readable lowercase and generous air between its letters. Stilu sets the tone above it, polished and even in its monoline strokes, while Hoover supplies the sturdy, easy-reading weight.

curated-gf-passero-one-gf-scope-one: Passero One is bold and expressive, its evenly drawn lines closing around tiny, tucked-in openings. Scope One answers with a roomy serif lowercase, wide open and easy in small doses.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-hedvig-letters-s: New Title opens big and tight, its large lowercase packed with close letter spacing and a bold, modern attitude. Hedvig Letters Sans answers with wide-open shapes, so the pair feels confident yet approachable and easy to read.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-old-persia: Understated and graceful, Telma writes its letters like a pen in motion, with open counters and a lowercase that reads big. Noto Sans Old Persian answers with clear, uncrowded shapes and a plain sans calm, best kept to brief copy.

curated-fs-britney-gf-urbanist: Loose and calligraphic, Britney keeps every stroke the same weight. Britney is best at carrying a lively voice in a few lines, while Urbanist, a plain sans with roomy letters, is best at staying calm beneath it.

curated-dafont-thunderstorm-fs-neco: Neco reads as a dignified text serif, its open-bellied letters calm and authoritative. Thunderstorm answers with small, tightly spaced script of even weight, so the pair moves from lively to composed, though that script is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-comico-bitter: Whimsical Comico stands tall, with generous spacing and strokes of one uniform weight, giving the heading real command. Bitter, a dependable slab-serif, answers with sturdy, open letters that keep the page grounded.
curated-special-elite-gf-asap-condensed: Asap Condensed reads neutral and tidy, its roomy lowercase tucked into snug, economical spacing. But Special Elite arrives scuffed and typewritten, its generous letters breathing out over the top of the page.

curated-special-elite-gf-sumana: Special Elite arrives scruffy and typewritten, with a big lowercase and letters that breathe freely. Sumana follows as a text serif, dignified and classic, its stroke only slightly varied in weight.

curated-gf-galdeano-gf-alice: Alice opens the serif body, bookish and refined, and might even suit a word search. Galdeano sits above as a petite, tightly spaced sans-serif, so the lowercase heights differ and the two never blur together.

curated-gf-kumar-one-gf-marcellus-sc: Kumar One opens with compact, enclosed letters spaced generously apart, while Marcellus SC answers with airy, open forms and a dignified literary tone. Their strongest quality is that clash between closed and open, commanding and calm.

curated-bricolage-grotesque-fs-nunito: Bricolage Grotesque opens with a big, roomy lowercase and clear, uncrowded shapes that could easily carry a technical recruiter resume. Nunito, a friendly sans-serif, follows with that same open, approachable build.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-zcool-kuaile: ZCOOL KuaiLe draws a sans-serif body in lines of one consistent weight, approachable but professional, beneath Chubbo's casual, inviting display heading with its open c and e. Both fonts keep an even, friendly stroke, so the pair reads as one voice.

curated-fs-chubbo-gf-bbh-hegarty: Chubbo opens its letters wide, casual and inviting right away. BBH Hegarty answers with compact, enclosed shapes and a neutral calm, handy for a handful of lines on a kids birthday invitation.
curated-dafont-punkboy-fs-public-sans: Bold and commanding, Punkboy packs compact curves that nearly close up on themselves. Public Sans answers with wide-open letters, so the heavy heading feels grounded by a plain sans that lets the eye breathe.

curated-dafont-hammerhead-gf-podkova: Hammerhead stamps out industrial, authoritative letters with no thick-thin variation at all. Podkova follows as a bookish text serif, its wide-open shapes softening the heading's hard, even weight into something readable.

curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Bold and modern, New Title packs its large lowercase letters in tight. Noto Sans Lydian answers with a roomy, approachable sans-serif body that lets everything breathe, so the dense heading never crowds the page.

curated-gf-bacasime-antique-gf-noto-sans: Dignified Bacasime Antique leads with dramatic thick and thin strokes and tightly set letters, a heading with real authority. Noto Sans KR, a roomy and open sans-serif, answers calmly, say, for a science lab report.
curated-fs-segment-gf-allerta: Segment opens wide and commanding, its big, roomy lowercase leaving every letter shape clear and uncrowded. Allerta follows in a plain sans, airy and neutral, its tall lowercase good for a handful of lines.
curated-dafont-ruritania-fs-roundo: Ornate and fantastical, Ruritania packs small lowercase into tight, enclosed shapes. Roundo, a plain sans with open, even strokes, reads comfortably in small doses (gothic cathedral lettering would suit the top).
curated-gf-cedarville-cursive-gf-overpas: Loose pen-and-paper letters lead in Cedarville Cursive, with a little life in every stroke. Overpass follows in an even monoline, so the handwritten warmth stays comfortable in small doses and never tires the eye.
curated-gf-nerko-one-gf-sedan: Nerko One writes in casual pen-and-paper loops, curves nearly closing. Its handwritten charm is best in small doses, while Sedan, a classic serif, lets soft modulation and open letters breathe.
curated-gf-mea-culpa-gf-noto-sans-sora-s: Graceful handwriting leads in Mea Culpa, with a pen-and-paper looseness and bold swings between thick and thin. Noto Sans Sora Sompeng answers with open, short-lowercase letters that stay modern, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-freehand-gf-lexend-tera: Commanding Freehand, packed tight with small counters, could headline a cabin rental sign. Lexend Tera answers with open, evenly weighted, widely spaced sans-serif letters, though in long paragraphs that airy spacing would tire the eye.
curated-dafont-upheaval-gf-libertinus-mo: Upheaval comes in bold and commanding, its letters nearly shut at the openings and spaced generously around a big lowercase. And Libertinus Mono answers with open, lively monospace strokes that feel precise, easy to read in small doses.
curated-gf-my-soul-gf-nanum-gothic: Relaxed and hand-drawn, My Soul keeps its lowercase short and tightly closed up (handy for a reading journal). Nanum Gothic answers with plain sans letters, open and roomy inside, though not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-boska-gf-dongle: Dramatic and bookish, Boska swings from bold to fine strokes, a flourish a bridal website could borrow. Dongle answers that swing with sans lines of one even weight, wide-open yet tightly set.
curated-libre-caslon-display-gf-aref-ruq: Graceful and editorial, Libre Caslon Display sits low with lively thick and thin strokes. Aref Ruqaa Ink answers with a taller, wide-open body whose strokes swell only mildly, and it reads comfortably in small doses.
curated-gf-nerko-one-ibm-plex-serif: Pen-and-paper handwriting with tight, nearly closed curves makes Nerko One feel right for a pregnancy journal, while IBM Plex Serif opens up beneath it. Nerko One gives quick personal charm; IBM Plex Serif answers with wide-open clarity.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Noto Sans Nushu feels contemporary and open, with big-reading lowercase letters that breathe easily. Noto Sans Nushu keeps things plain and even in small doses, while Telma handles the graceful, pen-written flow.
curated-fs-aktura-gf-kode-mono: Kode Mono is a monospace with open, roomy letters, ideal for a database schema diagram. Aktura answers above with tight little counters and small, commanding lowercase, so the heading feels dramatic while the body stays precise and wide open.
curated-fs-telma-gf-georama: Graceful Telma writes its letters with a flowing pen and open counters. Georama stays airy and tall beneath it, so a handful of lines, say a bridal shower invitation, read easily without strain.
curated-fs-rx-100-gf-noto-serif-dogra: Noto Serif Dogra opens with a bookish, large lowercase and strokes that carry some life, while RX100 stays tight, even and futuristic above it. A handful of lines reads comfortably, then the page wants a rest.
curated-gf-grand-hotel-gf-ysabeau-sc: Personal and inviting, Grand Hotel sets small pen-and-paper letters across the top. Grand Hotel handwrites a warm, slightly varied stroke, while Ysabeau SC, a sans with airy openings, stays modern and best for brief copy.
curated-fs-britney-gf-noto-sans-manichae: Noto Sans Manichaean reads clear and uncrowded, modern without any fuss. Britney adds a relaxed, calligraphic hand at one steady line weight, and that evenness makes the pair feel so cohesive.
curated-dafont-honey-script-outfit: Outfit reads open and easy, with airy c and e shapes and one even weight throughout. Outfit stays comfortable over a handful of lines, say for a kids app title.
curated-gf-birthstone-gf-sedan: Birthstone writes small and petite, a friendly handwritten heading with low lowercase letters and snug spacing. Sedan answers in a text serif that breathes, its strokes softly modulated and bookish.
curated-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao stands tall and open, with generous counters, and sits beneath Audiowide's evenly drawn, wide-spaced, futuristic letters. Together they feel like a console readout and a calm voice explaining it.
curated-fs-nippo-gf-ubuntu-condensed: Ubuntu Condensed reads as a tall, tightly set sans-serif, calm and businesslike. Nippo's large lowercase and even line weight give the pair a crisp, technical edge, better for brief copy.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-alegreya: Alegreya sets a warm, bookish serif body, its strokes softening and swelling with a handwritten ease. And Rajdhani's tightly set, evenly drawn lines above it keep the heading crisp and modern.
curated-gf-londrina-outline-gf-rokkitt: Londrina Outline opens with bold, commanding letters drawn in one even weight and packed close together. Rokkitt follows with wide-open, bookish shapes, and a handful of lines reads comfortably beneath it.
curated-gf-share-tech-gf-ovo: Contemporary and tightly set, Share Tech draws every stroke at one weight while Ovo answers with a bigger-reading serif. Their difference is the point: machine-even lines against letters with a little life.
curated-gf-fruktur-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads as a dignified serif, its c and e openings wide and airy. Fruktur answers with a commanding display face that earns its place big and short, tight counters and all.
curated-gf-atomic-age-gf-copse: Loud and a little retro, Atomic Age carries a hint of stroke variation, while Copse stays low-contrast with airy, open c and e shapes. Atomic Age grabs the eye up top; this classic serif keeps the reading comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-playwrite-be-vlg-gf-josefin-s: Graceful handwriting leads in Playwrite BE VLG, its low-sitting lowercase and roomy letters feeling right for a guest book. Josefin Slab answers as a serif of even weight, short and uncrowded, though not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-shantell-sans-gf-bhutuka-expa: Shantell Sans draws every letter in one even weight, loose and hand-made, with open, uncrowded shapes throughout the line. BhuTuka Expanded One answers as a text serif, so give it generous size to show off its airy spacing.
curated-gf-kelly-slab-gf-xanh-mono: Kelly Slab comes in bold and commanding, its clear, uncrowded shapes holding a heading with real authority. Xanh Mono answers in a quieter, typewriter-like way, fixed-width and airy inside, handy for a code snippet image.
curated-gf-cherry-swash-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk reads as a neutral, contemporary sans-serif, with airy openings in letters like c and e. And Cherry Swash takes the commanding lead, its evenly drawn monoline strokes and open counters standing out against that quiet body.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-geom: Geom's lowercase letters read big and friendly, which could suit an open source portfolio CV, while JetBrains Mono adds fixed-width, code-style structure up top. Longer passages in Geom would go down easily, since the sans-serif feels approachable and relaxed.
curated-special-elite-gf-alumni-sans-pin: Special Elite opens with a worn, distressed look and a large lowercase that lets every letter breathe. Alumni Sans Pinstripe answers with tight, evenly drawn lines, a quiet foil to all that grit.
curated-dafont-maxwell-fs-merriweather-s: Merriweather Sans opens wide, with tall lowercase letters and generous counters. Maxwell does clean, contemporary display work with one even stroke weight and low letters, while Merriweather Sans reads big and easy in text.
curated-gf-playwrite-ro-guides-gf-im-fel: IM Fell Great Primer SC reads as a bookish classic serif, with a faint old-print wobble, that might anchor a junk journal. Playwrite RO Guides writes across the top in loose, widely spaced pen strokes, the swelling thick-to-thin of a quick hand.
curated-dafont-blockletter-fs-epilogue: Blockletter's lowercase stands tall and uniform, with no thick and thin strokes, so the heading feels precise. Epilogue follows with open, roomy letters at one consistent weight, which keeps a longer read easy and approachable.
curated-gf-iceland-gf-junge: Commanding from the first line, Iceland draws every stroke at one weight. Iceland hits hardest in a handful of lines, while the text serif Junge opens wide and flows on.
curated-fs-britney-gf-gowun-batang: Britney writes in one even, relaxed monoline stroke, maybe for a wedding favor tag. Gowun Batang follows as a refined literary serif with airy, open letters, and its design suits brief stretches of reading.
curated-silkscreen-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Silkscreen draws every letter as a chunky, evenly weighted pixel line, loosely spaced and unmistakably retro, like an old arcade screen. Noto Sans Linear A answers with calm, open letters.
curated-dafont-bit-cell-clash-grotesk: Bit Cell opens with a digital, retro feel, its strokes softly modulated and its counters tight. Clash Grotesk answers in sans-serif strokes of one even weight, approachable and clean (handy for holographic hud text).
curated-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-arimo: Loose, friendly handwriting with wide-open c and e shapes, all in one even weight. Fuzzy Bubbles brings the warm, personal feel, while Arimo, a plain sans, brings tall lowercase and generous open counters for a neutral, professional tone.
curated-gf-style-script-gf-overpass-mono: Overpass Mono sets down evenly drawn, fixed-width monospace letters with airy spacing, while Style Script above it looks hand-written and slightly varied in stroke. Spread across many lines, its fixed rhythm stays orderly but tires the eye, better for brief copy.
curated-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-tagal: Distressed and a little rebellious, Special Elite types out its heading with roomy, breathing letters. Noto Sans Tagalog follows in a clean, neutral sans-serif, so longer reading stays calm and open, say, on a screen print poster tee.
curated-gf-galdeano-gf-courier-prime: Galdeano tucks its small, petite lowercase letters close together, giving the heading a professional, contemporary feel that stays compact. Courier Prime stands tall in monospace, with strokes of one weight and clear, uncrowded shapes.
curated-gf-poor-story-gf-pavanam: Pavanam reads crisp and modern, its tight spacing leaving every letter clear. Poor Story's wide-open, monoline shapes feel loud and commanding up top, so long paragraphs would wear thin, and Pavanam's lower lowercase sits smaller beneath.
curated-gf-handlee-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Handlee's wide-open, hand-drawn letters bring a loose, casual warmth above the page. Hedvig Letters Serif follows as a classic serif with large lowercase and breathing room, comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-bahianita-gf-mada: Bahianita commands the top with tightly set, closed letters and even lines, a good fit for a triathlon event poster. Mada answers with a plain sans that opens up wide, its lowercase reading big.
curated-clash-display-gf-amethysta: Amethysta, a classic text serif, sits under Clash Display's precise, strikingly plain letterforms. Reading much past a few lines would start to feel stiff, since this pair was never made for long paragraphs.
curated-clash-display-gf-stoke: Stoke reads as a loose, open-spaced serif with a faint stroke variation, bookish and editorial (a nice fit for a clothing tag logo). Clash Display above it stays plain and precise, with almost no contrast between thick and thin.
curated-gf-fleur-de-leah-gf-tsukimi-roun: Fleur De Leah swings hard between thick and thin, like a pen pressed down then lifted. Tsukimi Rounded stays plain sans and open, every stroke one weight, so a handful of lines reads easily.
curated-gf-playwrite-es-deco-gf-kaisei-t: Playwrite ES Deco looks like loose pen-and-paper writing, with low-slung lowercase letters drawn at one even weight. Kaisei Tokumin, a classic serif, swells and thins sharply, with open counters that look dignified.
curated-fs-khand-gf-maitree: Crisp and tightly spaced, Khand draws every line at one even weight, while Maitree answers with soft modulation. Maitree's open, roomy letters keep a longer run of text easy on the eye.
curated-gf-saira-extra-condensed-fs-hoov: Hoover reads as a roomy text serif, its lowercase big and its letters breathing easily. And a long stretch of it would go down unhurried, with Saira Extra Condensed staying tight and monoline above.
curated-gf-shizuru-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet stands tall and open, with lowercase letters that breathe and an easy, approachable manner. And Shizuru answers with bold, even strokes and a lowercase that sits low, plainly a display face.
curated-gf-playwrite-sk-guides-gf-aobosh: Playwrite SK Guides writes in a graceful, casual pen-and-paper hand, its short lowercase letters drawn at one even weight. Aoboshi One answers as a classic serif, petite and evenly stroked, so the whole pair feels steady and small.
curated-gf-butterfly-kids-gf-cutive: Cutive opens with roomy, breathing letters and a refined, literary feel, while Butterfly Kids leans in low, compact, and hand-drawn. Cutive would turn airy and a little tiring across many lines, so it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-tiro-bangla: Crisp and compact, Rajdhani draws every line at one even weight, tightly set and unmistakably modern. Tiro Bangla answers with lively strokes that run from bold to fine, comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-kablammo-fs-quicksand: Kablammo arrives with tall lowercase, wide spacing and a faint wobble of stroke variation that feels commanding. Quicksand stays even and open, so the pair reads as loud and friendly together.
curated-gf-gabarito-gf-livvic: Gabarito draws every line at an even weight, with wide open counters that give each heading real personality. Livvic follows in the same easy spirit, a friendly sans whose letters have plenty of room to breathe.
curated-gf-bowlby-one-sc-fs-alpino: Bowlby One SC hits hard, its tight, closed-in shapes standing tall and bold. Alpino answers with open, breathing letters and a cozy, casual sans feel, which makes the pair better for brief copy.
curated-gf-ranga-gf-m-plus-1p: Ranga opens with tight, expressive letters drawn at one even weight, giving the heading a distinct and slightly quirky voice. M PLUS 1p keeps its wide-open sans shapes neutral and easy for a handful of lines.
curated-gf-playwrite-ca-guides-fs-bespok: Bespoke Serif reads as dignified and authoritative, a text serif with only a slight variation in stroke weight. But Playwrite CA Guides leads with small, hand-drawn lowercase letters, so long paragraphs would feel better avoided.
curated-clash-display-gf-bbh-bartle: Striking from the first glance, Clash Display leads with a plain, confident build. It grabs attention in a few bold words, while BBH Bartle's roomy neutral letters carry brief copy (a running club shirt, maybe).
curated-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-bitter: Bitter opens the pair as a dependable slab-serif with tall lowercase and clear, uncrowded shapes that feel planted firmly in place. Baloo Tammudu 2 above it sounds commanding, big and open-lettered, almost loud beside that calm.
curated-dafont-mexcellent-fs-azeret-mono: Nostalgic and a little retro, Mexcellent stands tall with uniform strokes and tight, nearly shut-in counters. Azeret Mono answers with wide-open letters and generous breathing room between each character, comfortable in small doses.
curated-dafont-crust-clean-gf-bree-serif: Commanding is the word for Crust Clean, with tall lowercase letters and compact curves that nearly close up. Bree Serif follows with a refined, literary voice, its lowercase generous in height.
curated-space-mono-gf-anta: Space Mono opens with fixed-width, code-style letters, quirky and loosely spaced (handy for a slide deck at a tech talk). Anta follows as a calm, open sans that matches its single even line weight.
curated-gf-benne-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono opens wide and roomy, a monospace with a big lowercase that gives an api reference plenty of air. Victor Mono handles precise, structured detail, while Benne handles dignity, its tight, clear serif letters carrying a headline with quiet authority.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-ubuntu-cond: Cinzel Decorative opens with airy, commanding capitals whose strokes keep a little life in them, as if on a calligraphy practice sheet. Ubuntu Condensed answers in a tight, tall sans of one even weight, plain and professional.
curated-gf-kings-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Noto Sans Javanese reads wide open and neutral, a calm sans that might sit beside a leatherwork stamp. And Kings brings graceful, hand-drawn warmth to display, while the sans stays plain and works best for brief copy.
curated-gf-ponnala-gf-radio-canada: Ponnala opens with a commanding, tightly spaced display voice, its closed letters standing firm above the roomy, open lowercase of Radio Canada. Together they stay comfortable in small doses, with weight and breathing room.
curated-gf-museomoderno-gf-cutive: MuseoModerno comes in bold and expressive, plain in build (even a spellbook cover could carry it). Cutive follows as a refined text serif with roomy, breathing letters, best kept away from long paragraphs.
curated-gf-astloch-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads wide and open, with even strokes, say, for a sports fan tee. Astloch sits above it, tight and bold with low stroke contrast, so the heading hits hard while the sans below stays relaxed and roomy.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Literary and refined, Bonny sets a serif heading with airy openings in its c and e. Noto Sans Cypriot answers with open, approachable sans letters, where Bonny carries a mild swell through its strokes and the other stays level and calm.
curated-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-bu: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display opens its letters wide and lets its lowercase rise tall, say, for a halloween party invitation. Noto Sans Buhid answers plainly, its open shapes keeping long lines easy and modern to read.
curated-gf-reem-kufi-gf-taviraj: Taviraj reads like a well-edited book, with open counters and gently varied strokes. Reem Kufi sits above it as a clean, neutral sans-serif with a modest lowercase, so the two meet on one page without competing.
curated-gf-kavoon-gf-blinker: Blinker reads easy and open, its tall lowercase and roomy counters made for short stretches of reading. Blinker also holds steady against Kavoon, whose tight, closed-in letters make a loud, expressive headline.
curated-gf-corben-gf-englebert: Corben opens with a bold, gentle thick-to-thin swing, its c and e wide and airy. Englebert answers in plain sans, tightly set and uniform in stroke, comfortable in small doses.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-shippori-mincho: Crisp and modern up top, Rajdhani draws every line at one weight, while Shippori Mincho answers with a classic serif's gentle modulation. Make the heading small and those tight lines crowd, say, dyslexia friendly materials.
curated-gf-red-rose-gf-saira: Commanding and a little theatrical, Red Rose fills the top with tall lowercase letters and airy, open shapes. Saira follows in a neutral, plain sans, generous in height and just as uncrowded, so the pair feels easy to read.
curated-boska-gf-alan-sans: Boska opens with dramatic, bookish strokes that swing from bold to fine (handy for an alumni magazine). Alan Sans answers with clear, uncrowded letters that keep a quieter, modern tone.
curated-dafont-carrington-plus-jakarta-s: Carrington draws tight, quiet calligraphy with a romantic, even-handed stroke. Its strength is a few lines of hand-lettered mood, while Plus Jakarta Sans answers with open, precisely drawn letters that keep longer text easy.
curated-gf-cormorant-garamond-gf-sometyp: Sometype Mono sets fixed-width, monoline letters with airy openings, a structured monospace voice for, say, a bingo card. Cormorant Garamond is the literary one, low-slung and wide-open, while the body keeps things technical.
curated-gf-playwrite-be-vlg-gf-anonymous: Playwrite BE VLG writes its heading in a loose, graceful hand, with lowercase that sits low and roomy letters. And Anonymous Pro answers in typewriter-even monospace, so the pair swings between pen and machine, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-life-savers-gf-istok-web: Commanding is Life Savers, with wide-open letters and petite lowercase, while Istok Web answers with a moderate x-height and airy, approachable counters. Life Savers would do well at a big size, with Istok Web quieter below.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-mallanna: Oswald opens with a confident, tightly packed heading that stands tall and strong. Mallanna follows with neutral, contemporary letter shapes that stay clear and uncrowded despite their close spacing, so the pair reads as bold but calm.
curated-gf-playwrite-ie-guides-gf-montag: Montaga reads like a bookish, editorial serif with generous open counters and strokes of one even weight. Montaga does its best work in brief copy, so keep the body size modest and let it breathe.
curated-gf-miltonian-tattoo-gf-reddit-mo: Reddit Mono reads open and uncrowded, its fixed-width monospace letters drawn evenly and comfortable in small doses. Reddit Mono keeps things structured while Miltonian Tattoo commands attention with tight, near-closed curves, say, on a bootcamp landing page.
curated-gf-iansui-gf-rem: Loose, friendly, and clearly drawn by hand, Iansui keeps every stroke one weight. Iansui gives a heading its warmth and personality, while REM keeps the body neutral, approachable, and comfortable in small doses.
curated-boska-gf-manjari: Boska sets a dramatic, bookish tone, its strokes swinging from bold to hairline fine. Manjari answers in sans-serif, its open counters and even lines making a longer read feel easy, approachable, and quietly professional.
curated-gf-kolker-brush-gf-alef: Alef opens as a plain sans with clear, uncrowded shapes, while Kolker Brush adds pen-and-paper warmth that might fit a quilt label. Anything longer than a handful of lines would read comfortably, though the handwriting asks for restraint.
curated-fs-gambarino-gf-host-grotesk: Authoritative Gambarino swells and thins in sharp, dramatic strokes across its letters. Host Grotesk, a sans-serif with airy, open c and e, keeps a long read calm (say, for a leather goods stamp).
curated-fs-khand-gf-im-fell-french-canon: Crisp, compact Khand headings hold one steady weight, while IM Fell French Canon below has airy, swinging strokes. Make the heading small and Khand loses its snap, though a goal setting sheet might forgive it.
curated-fs-excon-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads tall and airy, with roomy openings inside each letter. Excon packs its wide-open shapes tightly and holds one even stroke weight, while the body keeps only a faint thick-thin shift.
curated-gf-jersey-25-charted-gf-almendra: Jersey 25 Charted comes in bold and commanding, its letters tucked tight around small openings, for western film titles, say. Almendra follows as a dignified text serif with a large lowercase that reads easily across a handful of lines.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-noto-sans-i: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads open and approachable, with tall lowercase and roomy letter shapes. Cinzel Decorative commands attention with airy spacing and lively strokes, while the plain sans simply stays easy to read.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-ibm-plex-sans-conden: Kalam opens with a cozy, hand-drawn warmth, like a note scribbled for a friend or an elopement announcement. IBM Plex Sans Condensed adds clear, modern order that handwriting lacks, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-playwrite-nz-gf-wittgenstein: Wittgenstein opens as a wide-open text serif, its thick and thin strokes swinging with a literary, traditional feel. Playwrite NZ sits above in petite, evenly drawn pen-and-paper letters, though pages with only a little copy suit this pair more happily.
curated-fs-array-gf-cambo: Array opens wide and precise, its tall lowercase giving a tiny house site a futuristic front door. And Cambo follows in serif, bookish and a little warm, with just enough stroke variation to feel human.
curated-gf-bodoni-moda-gf-iosevka-charon: Bodoni Moda swings hard between fat and hairline strokes, with a low-slung lowercase that feels formal. Iosevka Charon answers with fixed-width monospace letters drawn at one even weight, structured and technical.
curated-gf-explora-gf-shippori-mincho: Explora writes like a quick pen on paper, with short lowercase letters. Shippori Mincho follows as a serif with soft modulation and open, airy shapes in its c and e, and it reads best across a handful of lines.
curated-gf-engagement-gf-kodchasan: Engagement writes in a loose pen-and-paper hand, tight and relaxed, maybe on a band tour t-shirt. Kodchasan follows in a plain sans with open, evenly weighted strokes that keep longer reading calm.
curated-dafont-guttural-gf-holtwood-one-: Guttural draws every line at one consistent weight, packing compact, enclosed letters into a dense, commanding mass. Holtwood One SC takes the opposite approach, giving its text serif lowercase generous room, fine for a zombie walk poster but not long paragraphs.
curated-boska-gf-ysabeau-sc: Dramatic is the word for Boska, whose strokes swing from bold to fine with real theatrical flair. Ysabeau SC stays professional and modern, its airy c and e openings keeping the sans open.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-zen-antique-soft: Zen Antique Soft reads as a dignified serif with lively thick and thin strokes, and it's kinder to brief copy than to long text. Kalam's close-set, hand-drawn letters add a cozy warmth that softens its formality.
curated-gf-mynerve-gf-gilda-display: Relaxed and friendly, Mynerve draws every line at one even weight, like a hand that never presses harder. And Gilda Display answers with sharp swings from thick to thin, which is the whole point of the pairing.
curated-fs-oswald-gf-xanh-mono: Xanh Mono reads like typed code with roomy, open letters and a soft swell from thick to thin strokes. Oswald stands above it, tightly packed and confident, so the two feel loud and measured together.
curated-gf-potta-one-gf-noto-sans-sc: Commanding and bold, Potta One draws every line at a single weight with generous room between letters. Noto Sans SC stays neutral beside it, its wide-open shapes and tall-reading lowercase doing the quiet, modern work of the plain sans.
curated-boska-gf-noto-sans-mono: Boska's strokes swing from heavy to hairline-fine, giving the headings a dramatic, bookish pull. Noto Sans Mono answers with open counters and roomy letterspacing, so its body text reads big.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-miriam-libre: Contemporary and a little techy, JetBrains Mono sets fixed-width, roomy letters up top while Miriam Libre answers with smooth, uniform strokes below. Miriam Libre keeps a long read easy, its tall lowercase staying open and uncrowded.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-agdasima: Kalam brings a hand-drawn warmth, its letters tucked close together like a cozy huddle. Where Kalam is inviting and loose, Agdasima is the plain sans, open inside and evenly drawn, so short stretches of reading go down easily.
curated-gf-nanum-brush-script-gf-sura: Loose and personal, Nanum Brush Script writes like a quick pen note, its letters tucked tightly together. But Sura, a traditional serif with a hint of stroke variation, answers with more space and authority.
curated-gf-elsie-swash-caps-gf-noto-sans: Elsie Swash Caps swells and thins its strokes sharply, a commanding voice that might open some personal trainer branding. And Noto Sans Mandaic follows in a neutral, roomy sans whose open letters keep a handful of lines easy.
curated-gf-chicle-gf-kotta-one: Chicle comes in tight and commanding, its compact letters closed up like fists. Kotta One opens wide beneath it, its counters generous and its strokes unvaried, so the pair reads as opposites that share one page.
curated-dafont-another-danger-gf-stint-u: Another Danger comes in loud and commanding, a display face with a plain, no-fuss build. Stint Ultra Expanded answers with roomy, open serif letters, steady in weight from top to bottom.
curated-gf-monomakh-gf-asul: Asul reads as a refined, dignified classic serif, say, for a '60s record sleeve, made for short stretches of reading. Then Monomakh steps in with bold, expressive strokes that taper to fine, while Asul answers with softer, gentler modulation.
curated-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-gf-numans: Numans lays down a plain sans with wide open counters and tall lowercase, spaced loose and modern. Swanky and Moo Moo adds casual pen-and-paper handwriting that earns its keep big and short.
curated-raleway-gf-alegreya-sc: Alegreya SC opens with airy letters and a little life in every stroke. Raleway answers with uniform monoline strokes, so the text serif's small variations stand out against that plainness without either font crowding the other.

curated-gf-jaini-purva-fs-pilcrow-rounde: Bold and loud, Jaini Purva leads with a big roomy lowercase and even monoline strokes, while Pilcrow Rounded stays warm and neutral. Longer stretches of it would read easily, though a handful of lines suits it best.
curated-gf-sirin-stencil-gf-noto-sans-ta: Sirin Stencil commands attention with tall lowercase letters and monoline strokes that never thicken or thin. Noto Sans Tamil answers with a big, roomy sans, so its letters can sit a little smaller.
curated-special-elite-gf-sintony: Distressed and typewriter-rough, Special Elite has a large lowercase and roomy letters. Sintony answers with a tall, clean sans-serif body, and Special Elite earns its keep big and short, say on a sports fan tee.
curated-gf-londrina-solid-gf-noto-sans-n: Londrina Solid is bold and distinctive, every stroke drawn at one consistent weight. Noto Sans New Tai Lue answers with open, roomy counters and a neutral, modern calm, giving that loud heading quiet company, and it works best on brief copy.
curated-gf-league-gothic-fs-merriweather: League Gothic stands tall and tight, its enclosed counters packing every lowercase letter into a narrow, uniform monoline column. Merriweather Sans answers with wide-open counters, and its lowercase reads big without any help.
curated-gf-cormorant-unicase-gf-fragment: Fragment Mono reads structured and precise, with a large lowercase and loose, open spacing. Cormorant Unicase sits low and lively above it, its thick and thin strokes setting an editorial, authoritative tone against that even, one-weight monospace beneath.
curated-gf-prosto-one-gf-suez-one: Prosto One stands tall and airy, a commanding heading that might headline a movie night flyer. Suez One follows as a classic serif with compact curves that nearly close up, and Prosto One earns its keep when it runs big and short.
curated-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noticia-: Retro neon swagger, with Outrun Future spacing its tall, evenly weighted letters wide across the line. Noticia Text answers in a classic serif, dignified and open, with lowercase just as tall.
curated-lilita-one-gf-danfo: Lilita One opens with fat, even-weight strokes and tight, closed-in shapes that feel bouncy and loud. Danfo answers with a text serif, its spacing loose and its openings small and tucked away.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-tai-: Typewriter-tidy and wide open, JetBrains Mono gives the heading a coder's swagger, handy for an engineering blog if you want one. Noto Sans Tai Le handles the reading with its big, roomy lowercase.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-proza-libre: Inviting and cozy, Kalam writes its heading by hand, with letters tucked close together and a loose, drawn look. And Proza Libre follows with a plain, approachable sans-serif body, easy company for a wedding website, say.
curated-gf-chewy-gf-ubuntu-mono: Ubuntu Mono is a tall, even monospace with open, airy letters, set against Chewy's tight, enclosed lowercase. That clash gives the pair a loud, playful edge, say for laptop stickers.
curated-fs-rosaline-gf-peddana: Luxurious, pen-written Rosaline swings hard between bold and hairline strokes. Peddana, a classic serif underneath, keeps a calmer, gentler thick-to-thin rhythm that lets the flourish stand out, and the pair stays comfortable across a handful of lines.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-noto-sans-p: Cinzel Decorative opens with a commanding, refined air, its letters widely spaced and its strokes faintly alive. Noto Sans PhagsPa follows in a roomy, approachable sans-serif, so a longer stretch of text would read easily and openly.
curated-gf-fragment-mono-gf-noto-sans-gu: Fragment Mono types out every letter at the same width, with a stroke of uniform thickness. Noto Sans Gujarati answers with a big, roomy plain sans, and bumping its size up would suit, say, a stack overflow style Q&A.
curated-boska-gf-mona-sans: Dramatic and bookish, Boska swings its strokes from bold to fine, a serif with real theatrical flair (maybe for a personal blog). Mona Sans answers with wide-open, neutral letters, so the whole pair reads as a loud voice meeting a calm one.
curated-gf-erica-one-gf-noto-serif-tibet: Erica One sets its tight, closed-in letters far apart, loud and loosely spaced like a shout with elbow room. Noto Serif Tibetan follows with softly modulated strokes, and a longer stretch of it reads comfortably in small doses.
curated-tourney-gf-graduate: Graduate sets a dignified, bookish tone that might even suit a YouTube channel logo. Tourney answers with bold, athletic lettering at one even weight, and both fonts keep their spacing loose and open, so the page feels roomy rather than crowded.
curated-gf-kirang-haerang-gf-b612-mono: Expressive and tightly set, Kirang Haerang crouches low with enclosed counters, while B612 Mono answers in wide-open, fixed-width letters. Longer stretches in the monospace read evenly and airy, though a handful of lines suits it best.
curated-gf-sofia-gf-noto-sans-canadian-a: Sofia has a relaxed, hand-drawn feel, with even monoline strokes and roomy, open letters. But Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal stays neutral and wide-open beneath it, a sans-serif better for brief copy.
curated-gf-mr-de-haviland-gf-montaga: Casual and friendly, Mr De Haviland writes tight pen-and-paper letters with tucked-in openings, handy for a prayer journal. Montaga, an open-countered serif of uniform monoline strokes, sits comfortably in small doses beneath it.
curated-dafont-disorder-fs-karma: Raw and chaotic, Disorder sprawls across a headline in loose, open letters of one unvarying weight, like a punk gig flyer. And Karma follows in tall, tidy serif forms, its gentle stroke variation steadying everything beneath it.
curated-gf-rowdies-gf-volkhov: Commanding Rowdies tucks its curves in until they nearly close up. Volkhov follows as a classic serif with a little life in the line, and Rowdies earns its place when set big and brief.
curated-gf-playwrite-de-grund-guides-gf-: DM Mono sets the body in a monospace of one steady weight, with open c and e shapes. DM Mono reads precisely and technically, while Playwrite DE Grund Guides brings small, pen-and-paper lowercase letters that feel personal and casual.
curated-fs-red-hat-display-gf-im-fell-fr: Contemporary and bold, Red Hat Display draws every line at one even weight, with clear and uncrowded shapes. IM Fell French Canon answers with bookish strokes that swing sharply between thick and thin.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-noto-sans-m: Commanding and refined, Cinzel Decorative opens with airy spacing and strokes that carry a little life. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui follows in a calm sans-serif, large and open (maybe for moving and relocation).
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-gf-anonymo: Relaxed and friendly, Edu VIC WA NT Hand sits low, with open, hand-drawn letters and generous counters. Anonymous Pro answers in precise monospace, every character the same width, though it was not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-joti-one-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif sits low and literary, a text serif with refined manners and a generous lowercase height. Joti One commands the top in bold, one-weight strokes with tall letters and curves nearly closed.
curated-gf-caprasimo-gf-yuji-boku: Yuji Boku, a text serif drawn in evenly weighted lines with airy c and e openings, suits short stretches of reading (a gothic novel cover, say). Caprasimo's tight, soft-modulated shapes give it a commanding heft.
curated-fredoka-pt-serif: Round, even-stroked Fredoka greets you first, friendly and open (very thank you note cute). PT Serif sets a traditional text serif underneath, its soft modulation keeping longer stretches of reading calm and trustworthy.
curated-fs-rosaline-gf-gfs-didot: Ink-wet and glamorous, Rosaline flows with sharp thick-and-thin swings and snug, enclosed counters, a nod to a holiday party invite. Rosaline carries the drama, while GFS Didot, a text serif, offers open, literary calm.
curated-archivo-black-gf-noto-serif-dive: Archivo Black opens with big, roomy lowercase letters and a loud, urban authority that fills the line. Noto Serif Dives Akuru follows with tall, refined letters and a faint stroke variation.
curated-gf-nothing-you-could-do-baskervv: Nothing You Could Do looks hand-drawn and relaxed, with short lowercase letters in an even, open line. But Baskervville's text serif swings hard between thick and thin, and its petite letters would wear thin over long paragraphs.
curated-gf-baloo-2-gf-noticia-text: Expressive and openly friendly, Baloo 2 leads with tall, uncrowded lowercase letters that never feel cramped. But Noticia Text answers as a literary, dignified text serif, its wide letters giving long reading a calm, unhurried pace.
curated-fs-kola-gf-oxygen-mono: Kola brings a bold, plain display voice, the sort a status bar and tabs might borrow. Oxygen Mono follows with airy, fixed-width letters that feel structured, though not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-noto-serif-lao-gf-onest: Tall, evenly weighted lowercase gives the sans-serif body in Onest a friendly, uncrowded, thoroughly contemporary feel. Onest sits steadily under Noto Serif Lao, whose slight stroke variation and large lowercase lend the heading a traditional, classic air.
curated-gf-playpen-sans-deva-gf-lekton: Lekton reads as tidy, fixed-width monospace letters, each one clear and given its own room. Playpen Sans Deva sits above it like a casual hand-written note, open and friendly against that structure.
curated-gf-pathway-gothic-one-gf-faustin: Professional and tightly packed, Pathway Gothic One stands its lowercase tall, with letters pressed close together above Faustina. Faustina, a text serif, answers with soft strokes and roomy, open counters.
curated-fs-telma-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Telma writes in flowing, pen-made letters with open counters and a gentle swell, and its lowercase reads large. Noto Sans Old Sogdian answers with tall, breathing lowercase, though it works better for brief copy than for long reading.
curated-gf-playwrite-br-guides-gf-rosari: Friendly pen-and-paper letters in Playwrite BR Guides swing sharply between thick and thin, giving the heading a loose, breathing handwritten feel. Rosario keeps things open and approachable, sitting low and steady beneath.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Literary and refined up top, Bonny has soft stroke modulation, open letters like c and e, and close-knit spacing. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi gives the contrast, plain and low in modulation, with letters that breathe.
curated-gf-playwrite-br-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao stands tall and open, with generous counters and a modern feel. Playwrite BR answers with short, airy handwritten letters that breathe, relaxed and friendly, so the sans-serif body can run a touch larger.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-tiktok-sans: Bold and modern, New Title crowds its big lowercase letters tight, like a headline that means it. TikTok Sans answers with the same tall lowercase, but gives each shape room (maybe for a product launch deck).
curated-gf-yomogi-gf-readex-pro: Yomogi draws every stroke at one weight, open and hand-made, like a friendly note. Readex Pro follows with clear, evenly drawn lines and a tall lowercase that keeps long reading calm and easy to follow.
curated-megrim-gf-saira-condensed: Saira Condensed packs tight, even-weight letters into a plain sans-serif voice. Megrim above it draws angular, wide-open shapes with tall lowercase, and that sharp futuristic edge against such quiet, compact text is the pair's whole appeal.
curated-unbounded-gf-noto-serif-dives-ak: Friendly and wide-open, Unbounded spreads its letters out with loose spacing and generous lowercase height, almost leaning into the room around it. Noto Serif Dives Akuru answers below, tall and slightly varied in stroke.
curated-gf-birthstone-bounce-gf-im-fell-: IM Fell English SC, a bookish serif, could carry letters to future self nicely. Birthstone Bounce adds lively, pen-and-paper swings in thick and thin above it, while the serif body stays clear and uncrowded.
curated-fs-red-hat-display-gf-agdasima: Agdasima reads as a plain sans, with open, roomy letters and a modern, neutral tone throughout. And Red Hat Display leads with bold, contemporary confidence, drawn at one consistent weight, so a noticeably larger heading feels natural.
curated-gf-edu-sa-hand-gf-source-code-pr: Source Code Pro is a monospace body with typewriter-like even-width letters and airy spacing, made for short stretches of reading. Edu SA Hand brings pen-and-paper grace; Source Code Pro brings precision.
curated-gf-salsa-fs-paquito: Paquito opens up with a big, roomy lowercase and a confident, approachable feel, while Salsa commands the heading, say, on a surf shop sign. Longer stretches of the text serif stay comfortable only in small doses.
curated-gf-dekko-fs-trench-slab: Dekko leads with casual pen-and-paper letters, airy in the c and e, with a lowercase that stands tall. Trench Slab follows as a roomy text serif, dignified and refined, best taken a handful of lines at a time.
curated-gf-patrick-hand-sc-gf-noto-sans-: Noto Sans Cypriot is an approachable sans-serif with plenty of open space inside each letter. Noto Sans Cypriot meets Patrick Hand SC's tight pen-and-paper scrawl with calm shapes, say, on a road trip scrapbook.
curated-fs-bonny-gf-telex: Bonny's hint of stroke variation gives the heading a literary, refined air, with tightly knit spacing and roomy c and e. Telex follows in a plain, open-lettered sans that stays out of the way and keeps things neutral.
curated-dafont-angeline-vintage-fs-plein: Plein opens wide and plain, a calm foil for a heading that might dress a vintage matchbook. Plein's roomy shapes let Angeline Vintage's close-knit, nearly sealed curves stand out, good for a handful of lines.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-geo: Cinzel Decorative opens wide and airy, its strokes carrying a hint of life that feels commanding. Geo answers in one even weight, a plain sans with a big lowercase and tight spacing.
curated-gf-sedgwick-ave-mulish: Sedgwick Ave writes in a loose, friendly hand that feels graceful and relaxed. Mulish answers with even strokes and tall, airy lowercase letters, and it works for brief copy, so give the heading a bit more size.
curated-dafont-zag-fs-nunito: Zag opens with bold, commanding letters set tightly, its lowercase standing tall above the line. Nunito follows in a roomy, approachable lowercase, and long stretches of it would read easily and calmly.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-noto-sans-cune: Typewriter-tidy and airy, JetBrains Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters with open counters and roomy spacing across the top. Noto Sans Cuneiform follows as a sans with tall lowercase and plenty of open space inside each letter.
curated-gf-akshar-gf-poly: Akshar opens in a modern, neutral voice, its close-knit spacing and low stroke contrast feeling tidy and direct. Poly follows in a classic serif with open letters, which reads with a bookish ease.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-rocknroll-one: Kalam opens with a cozy, hand-drawn warmth, its letters tucked in close like quick handwriting. And RocknRoll One keeps the sans-serif body plain and approachable, which reads best as brief copy.
curated-fs-quilon-bitter: Bitter reads as a dependable slab-serif, with tall lowercase and clear, uncrowded letters. Quilon above it is commanding and editorial, its strokes carrying a little life, so leave the body generous in size and let those roomy shapes breathe.
curated-dafont-whitin-gf-bona-nova-sc: Relaxed and creative, Whitin crowds its closed letters tight and swings hard between thick and thin, say, for a film photography zine. Bona Nova SC answers with open letters and a gentler, lighter stroke.
curated-gf-norican-gf-yuji-boku: Yuji Boku keeps its lines even and its c and e wide open. Norican up top is the opposite, a tight, closed-in handwriting that looks scribbled on paper and varies more in weight.
curated-gf-klee-one-gf-anonymous-pro: Anonymous Pro lays down typewriter-even monospace letters with airy openings in its c and e. Klee One adds a graceful, pen-and-paper heading, and it earns its keep when big and short.
curated-boska-gf-rem: Boska opens with a dramatic, bookish character, its strokes swinging from bold down to hairline fine. Then REM answers in a neutral, approachable sans, every line drawn at one even weight.
curated-gf-playwrite-sk-gf-iosevka-charo: Playwrite SK opens relaxed and handwritten with short, evenly drawn lowercase, while Iosevka Charon answers in fixed-width, consistently weighted monospace. Long stretches of that monospace would tire the eye, so brief copy suits it better.
curated-dafont-adam-fs-sentient: Sentient reads as a tight, compact serif with small enclosed letters and a gentle bit of stroke modulation. Adam opens up the headline with roomy letters and one steady line weight, while Sentient gives the text a closed, slightly varied texture.
curated-gf-liu-jian-mao-cao-gf-fenix: Fenix, a text serif with wide-open letter shapes, anchors the page (a therapy notebook, say) beneath Liu Jian Mao Cao. Liu Jian Mao Cao's pen-drawn monoline strokes look casual, handwritten, and relaxed against Fenix's steadier editorial poise.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-yi: Bold, tightly spaced lowercase gives New Title a punchy, modern look. Noto Sans Yi answers with open counters and a calm, professional tone, so the pair feels like a confident shout followed by an easy, steady reply.
curated-dafont-venera-gf-major-mono-disp: Major Mono Display reads as an airy, evenly drawn monospace, the sort a code editor font might borrow. Major Mono Display keeps its tall strokes beneath Venera, whose roomy modern letters sit lower and looser.
curated-gf-mclaren-gf-poltawski-nowy: Poltawski Nowy brings a plain, literary serif voice, say, for a vintage badge emblem. McLaren heads the page with open, uncrowded letters and plenty of expressive personality, while the serif body stays traditional and calm underneath, made for short stretches of reading.
curated-special-elite-gf-spectral: Special Elite arrives with a big, tall lowercase and a worn, typewriter-struck roughness that never feels tidy. Spectral follows as a calm text serif, its gentle strokes and open letters (think classical recital poster) staying easy.
curated-gf-trade-winds-gf-biz-udpmincho: Bold and commanding, Trade Winds opens the page with a display voice and a hint of stroke variation. BIZ UDPMincho follows in a classic serif, its roomy, airy letters easing the loudness down. (30 words)
curated-fs-new-title-gf-moulpali: Quiet and open, the sans-serif body reads easily thanks to its tall lowercase and steady spacing. Moulpali stays calm under New Title, whose big lowercase and tight spacing would lose punch if shrunk.
curated-fs-telma-gf-rubik-mono-one: Rubik Mono One is a sans-serif with compact curves that nearly close and a roomy lowercase. Rubik Mono One reads easily in short stretches, say, for a rehearsal dinner invite, as Telma's flowing script softens everything.
curated-gf-galdeano-baskervville: Professional and compact, Galdeano leads with tight little lowercase letters, and Baskervville follows in a classic serif that suits an appointment card. Its strokes swing hard between thick and thin.
curated-fs-khand-gf-trirong: Khand arrives crisp and compact, every line drawn at one even weight, and it feels thoroughly contemporary. Khand states things quickly, while Trirong, the text serif, lets its open letters unspool.
curated-gf-crushed-gf-arvo: Arvo reads in a calm, dignified way, a classic serif with open letters, made for short stretches like an eyewear label. Crushed leads with a loud, bold display voice, its tight letters packed together, while Arvo stays composed below.
curated-fs-quilon-gf-grenze: Commanding Quilon spreads its big, roomy lowercase wide, a voice you could imagine on a yoga studio logo. But Grenze, a classic serif with tall, close-knit lowercase, would feel crowded across long paragraphs.
curated-dafont-reckoner-fs-gambetta: Reckoner leads with tight, even strokes, a fit for a property development brochure. Gambetta follows as a text serif, open inside and relaxed, so the page turns from crisp to calm.
curated-dafont-quantum-gf-pridi: Quantum opens the page with airy spacing and evenly drawn lines, a clean, techy voice. Pridi follows as a serif with roomy counters, softening that look with a classic, refined touch.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-blinker: Blinker reads open and approachable, its tall lowercase and generous counters keeping every line easy to follow. Blinker would carry a long stretch of text comfortably, each steady monoline stroke settling the eye while New Title stays loud above.
curated-gf-life-savers-gf-bhutuka-expand: Commanding Life Savers opens wide, with petite lowercase letters, a fine fit for a horror podcast cover. And BhuTuka Expanded One answers as a serif with one even weight and airy, open letters.
curated-fs-excon-gf-fira-code: Fira Code is a monospace with airy letter spacing and open c and e shapes, so every line feels roomy and unhurried. Excon is best at tight, evenly drawn lowercase, while Fira Code excels at generous openings.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Bold and modern up top: New Title sets large lowercase letters with tight, close spacing. And Noto Sans Nushu lets roomy letters breathe below, best with New Title big, short, say, on a real estate listing deck.
curated-gf-gidugu-gf-martian-mono: Approachable Gidugu leads with tight, nearly closed curves, maybe for a stack overflow style Q&A. Martian Mono answers in wide, roomy, fixed-width letters, structured and technical, so the two feel like a friendly question meeting a precise reply.
curated-fs-new-title-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Bold and modern, New Title stacks big lowercase letters in tight spacing. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian answers with calm, tall letters that stay uncrowded, a plain sans that suits a bookshop logo.
curated-gf-diplomata-sc-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads loose and open, every letter the same weight and given plenty of room to breathe. Fragment Mono suits small doses best, since a longer stretch of monospace would start to feel mechanical.
curated-gf-nova-flat-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Commanding is the word for Nova Flat, whose strokes hold one weight throughout, say, for a poster print shop merch run. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi is the sans-serif here, approachable, and its letters breathe, best in small doses.
curated-gf-libre-barcode-39-extended-tex: Lilex opens the pair with airy, fixed-width monospace letters, an easy fit for an engineering blog's code-heavy pages. Its heading counterpart, Libre Barcode 39 Extended Text, is tightly closed and loosely spaced.
curated-fs-striper-gf-rethink-sans: Striper opens graphic and playful, with a low-contrast build that feels relaxed instead of loud. And Rethink Sans follows with generous, open counters and strokes of one weight throughout, so the page reads smoothly.
curated-fs-khand-gf-cactus-classical-ser: Cactus Classical Serif reads as an open, easygoing text serif with only a faint hint of stroke variation. Khand sits above it, crisp and tightly spaced, its lines drawn at one even weight.
curated-fs-telma-gf-blinker: Telma's flowing, pen-written letters carry a soft modulation, graceful and understated, with open counters and tall lowercase forms. Blinker answers with evenly drawn lines, so the pair reads calm and clear.
curated-dafont-oldtimer-gf-yuji-boku: Classic and commanding, Oldtimer opens the page with generous, evenly drawn monoline letters. Yuji Boku, a serif, follows with airy c and e shapes, so reading feels dignified and unhurried, almost like turning pages in an old editorial.
curated-dafont-akira-expanded-clash-grot: Striking and expansive, Akira Expanded spreads its wide letters across the line with generous room between them. Clash Grotesk answers in strokes of one weight, calm and approachable, better for brief copy.
curated-gf-hanalei-fill-gf-ubuntu-sans-m: Commanding and bold, Hanalei Fill makes a statement with its large lowercase, and a shell prompt is one place it could sit. Ubuntu Sans Mono follows in even monoline strokes with open, tall letters that give the heading room.
curated-gf-buda-gf-quattrocento-sans: Buda sits low and tight, its c and e opening wide while the letters crowd close together. Quattrocento Sans lets its modern letters breathe, though it suits brief copy better than long runs.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-parastoo: Kalam opens with a loose, hand-drawn warmth that feels inviting and cozy. Parastoo follows as a serif with wide-open letters and gentle stroke variation, which suits brief copy more than long reading.
curated-fs-quilon-gf-faustina: Commanding and roomy, Quilon leads with big lowercase letters (a plumber van logo, maybe). Faustina follows as a text serif, softly modulated and generous inside each letter, so reading stays easy.
curated-dafont-hammerhead-gf-labrada: Hammerhead hits with an industrial, authoritative weight, its evenly drawn lines leaving generous open space inside every letter. Labrada, a dignified, bookish serif, keeps its shapes clear and uncrowded, and its strokes vary far more.
curated-gf-playwrite-ca-gf-datatype: Datatype sets typewriter-even monospace letters with generous open counters, precise and structured, under Playwrite CA's airy, low-slung handwriting. curated-gf-playwrite-vn-gf-ibarra-real-n: Ibarra Real Nova reads as a traditional, editorial text serif, its strokes swinging from bold to fine while the letters stay open. Playwrite VN adds a relaxed, monoline hand, say, for a reel text overlay, but a handful of lines is plenty.
curated-dafont-highway-gothic-fs-merriwe: Merriweather Sans reads big and open, a plain sans with roomy counters. Highway Gothic leads with tight spacing and one even stroke weight, so long reading stays calm, as on a hospital wayfinding sign.
curated-boska-gf-bbh-bartle: BBH Bartle sits plainly below, a neutral sans with generous room between its letters. Boska brings the drama above, its strokes swinging from bold to fine in a bookish way.
curated-jetbrains-mono-gf-numans: JetBrains Mono sets every letter in the same fixed width, with uniform strokes and open counters, like code on a screen. Numans answers with a sans-serif body that stands tall and loose, so give it extra size.
curated-gf-playwrite-cu-guides-gf-laila: Laila reads as an open, traditional serif with roomy letters and an editorial air. Playwrite CU Guides leans personal beside it, with low-slung handwriting and generous spacing, so the pair feels warm, though better for brief copy.
curated-gf-parisienne-gf-lilex: Graceful Parisienne leans in close, its modest lowercase carrying a soft, handwritten sway. Lilex answers in airy, fixed-width monospace, precise and open, a calm counterweight that could sit beside a line in a sheet music caption.
curated-gf-galdeano-fs-merriweather-sans: Professional and contemporary, Galdeano keeps its lowercase small and petite, with letters tucked close together. Merriweather Sans stands taller in its lowercase, and the open counters keep a long read, say a purchase receipt, easy.
curated-dafont-prime-gf-fragment-mono: Soft, friendly, a little roomy: Prime leads with big lowercase and gentle stroke shifts. Prime carries a warm, easygoing voice, while Fragment Mono keeps every line evenly drawn, precise, and calmly structured.

curated-gf-waterfall-gf-antic: Antic draws every line at one even weight, with airy, open c and e shapes. Waterfall's small, tightly set handwriting stays closed and casual, so a handful of lines reads relaxed and quick.
curated-fs-rosaline-gf-lateef: Luxurious and understated, Rosaline writes in flowing pen strokes that swing sharply between bold and hairline. And Lateef, a text serif with a mild swell, keeps the lines close and quiet beneath it.
curated-gf-playwrite-fr-trad-gf-grandifl: Grandiflora One keeps its lowercase short and evenly stroked, with open counters that give the serif a literary, confident voice. And Playwrite FR Trad sits above it as a friendly, hand-drawn script, comfortable to read in small doses.
curated-gf-coiny-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devana: Coiny arrives with compact, enclosed letters and roomy spacing, a chunky, expressive voice up top. And IBM Plex Sans Devanagari answers with wide-open counters, so the body feels airy beside it.
curated-unbounded-gf-pt-serif-caption: Unbounded sprawls wide across the line, its round letters loose and friendly, with lowercase that stands generously tall. PT Serif Caption reads like quiet editorial prose, its text serif strokes softly modulated and its tall lowercase easy to follow.

curated-caveat-gf-signika: Caveat opens with casual pen-and-paper letters, drawn at one steady weight, a possible fit for a scrapbook page. But Signika answers in a plain, modern sans-serif that keeps a handful of lines easy to read.
curated-fs-britney-gf-noto-sans-mongolia: Relaxed and expressive, Britney writes in a calligraphic hand with uniform monoline strokes that never thicken. Noto Sans Mongolian answers with wide-open, neutral letters, and that calm openness is the pair's strongest quality.
curated-eater-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu stays open and approachable, with airy c and e shapes. Eater snarls in big, soft-edged lowercase, fit for a metal band logo, while the sans keeps tall letters easygoing.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-madimi-one: Madimi One reads as approachable and clean, its tight, closed-in shapes sitting neatly under the heading. And Kalam's hand-drawn, close-set letters keep things cozy, built for short stretches of reading.
curated-gf-akaya-kanadaka-gf-belgrano: Belgrano opens the pair with wide, traditional letter shapes, while Akaya Kanadaka leads as a commanding display heading. And a longer stretch of reading in this text serif would feel brief and comfortable, never tiring.
curated-gf-im-fell-double-pica-space-gro: Refined and old-fashioned, IM Fell Double Pica sets small, lively letters tightly together up top, like a page from an old printing house. Space Grotesk answers in neutral, wide-open sans-serif forms, comfortable in small doses.
curated-gf-ruslan-display-fs-familjen-gr: Ruslan Display commands attention with loose, open spacing and softly modulated strokes, its closed letters sitting in a big lowercase. Familjen Grotesk answers in a plain sans with open, breathing letters, nicely suited to a handful of lines.
curated-dafont-amadeus-fs-erode: Bold and commanding, Amadeus spaces its monoline letters wide with open counters. Erode answers with a serif body that breathes, its strokes carrying a gentle thick-to-thin life that Amadeus never attempts.
curated-gf-playwrite-dk-uloopet-guides-g: El Messiri reads as an open, friendly sans-serif with soft modulation, made for short stretches of reading (a maker story card, say). And Playwrite DK Uloopet Guides sits above it as a hand-drawn heading, its compact lowercase running noticeably lower than the body.
curated-gf-dynapuff-manrope: Puffy, bold, and unapologetically loud: DynaPuff leads with roomy spacing and soft, even strokes. DynaPuff is best at grabbing attention with its tall lowercase and playful weight, while Manrope quietly keeps things readable through open counters and a steady, approachable sans voice.
curated-boska-gf-metrophobic: Metrophobic reads as a modern, open sans-serif, its c and e letting plenty of light in. Boska above it swings from bold to hairline fine, which shrinking it would waste.
curated-cinzel-decorative-gf-anek-devana: Anek Devanagari reads as a modern, neutral sans-serif, open and tall, maybe right for a hand lettered quote. Cinzel Decorative sits above it, refined and commanding, with a gentle thick-to-thin rhythm.
curated-fs-excon-gf-noto-sans-tc: Tight and wide-open at once, Excon sets its big lowercase in uniform monoline strokes. Noto Sans TC, a plain sans, lets its roomy letters breathe below, so the page moves from compact to easygoing.
curated-fs-styro-gf-alexandria: Commanding Styro sets big, compact lowercase letters that close in on themselves. Styro holds a line with a retro, authoritative punch, while Alexandria stays open and airy, with a roomy, easygoing sans rhythm and a plainspoken professional tone.
curated-gf-architects-daughter-gf-lilex: Relaxed and hand-drawn, Architects Daughter writes its heading in even, unhurried strokes with no thick or thin swing. Lilex follows in fixed-width monospace, airy and precise, which keeps a handful of lines tidy beside that loose hand.
curated-fs-britney-gf-ojuju: Britney opens with a relaxed, handwritten stroke of even weight and tight spacing. Ojuju answers with softly swelling strokes and wide-open shapes, which keeps a longer stretch of sans-serif text easy and approachable to read.
curated-fs-telma-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur stays level and open, strokes all one weight, a plain sans that reads big (say, in a travel agency brochure). Telma's flowing pen letters carry a soft thick-thin swing, a graceful touch above that even body.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-stoke: Kalam opens with a cozy, hand-drawn warmth, maybe right for a woodworking shop sign. Kalam handles that inviting, tightly set, personal feel, while Stoke brings a bookish text serif with loose, open spacing, though it was not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-dafont-dogica-work-sans: Dogica opens with a heavy, commanding voice, its big, roomy lowercase and airy spacing leaving generous open counters throughout. Dogica does the commanding, while Work Sans reads modern and evenly drawn, with plenty of open space inside.
curated-gf-freeman-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Commanding and compact, Freeman packs its letters tight around closed counters. Kdam Thmor Pro answers with tall, modern lowercase that feels lighter beside it, a calm voice after a loud one.
